allowed_input_index_digest.canonicalization: UTF-8 of ordered newline-separated path@github_blob_sha entries

method_observation.observation: Local-language institutional terms and domestic-trade labels unlock materially different actor classes than an English/global-company atlas, but recall quality falls quickly once the prompt turns into a country-by-country name list. A sparse terminology lens is useful; exhaustive geographic enumeration is not.

proposed_validation_probe.reason: The strongest remaining first-order blind-memory gap is marine insurance beyond P&I and war risk. P003 is selected for coverage value, not as a claim that one terminology observation deserves shared-method promotion.

stop_reason: The preset questions were answered with specific retained leads and explicit reviewed-no-specific-memory regions. Marginal recall then shifted toward uncertain company lineages, legal dates and country-by-country enumeration requiring Evidence or violating the sparse-map stop rule.
verification_note: Research content is intentionally Memory-only. Final remote worker boundary/continuity verification is recorded after raw, receipt and rebuilt map reach the substantive checkpoint.
